title: CI 报告必须区分最新成功运行与当前 HEAD 覆盖
summary: 存在 paths/path-filter 的仓库中，某工作流最新一次成功运行可能针对旧 commit。跨项目报告必须显示 run head SHA 是否等于当前主分支 HEAD，不能把‘latest success’静默表述成‘当前代码已验证’。
invariants: Report workflow run head SHA alongside current branch HEAD.
A successful run on an older SHA is labeled older/stale with respect to current HEAD.
Path-filtered absence of a new run is not automatically classified as failure.
CI coverage is not promoted to real-device/final-output evidence.
